# Rosetta's Home & Care Services

Official website: https://rosettahc.com/
Business location: 1425 N Dallas Ave STE 304-A, Lancaster, Texas 75134.
Service areas: Lancaster, DeSoto, Duncanville, Ovilla, Cedar Hill (Texas). The business office is in Lancaster.
Service area guide: https://rosettahc.com/service-areas.html
Service category: Non-medical home care and daily-living support.
Contact: (972) 878-7440; admin@rosettahc.com.

Rosetta's Home & Care describes support with personal care, light housekeeping, meal preparation, medication reminders, errands, transportation, and appointment coordination. Specific tasks, service availability, schedules, costs, and payment arrangements are confirmed directly with the team. This website does not offer medical diagnosis or emergency care. A consultation inquiry does not itself confirm a booking or insurance coverage.

For urgent medical needs, call 911. Do not submit diagnoses or medical records through the general inquiry form.
